defects: Antitone hypothesis is stated globally (Antitone f on all of ℝ) instead of restricted to AntitoneOn f (Icc 0 N) as in the gold, strengthening the hypothesis beyond what the informal statement requires

Integrability hypothesis is stated globally (MeasureTheory.Integrable f over ℝ) instead of IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0), strengthening the hypothesis to require integrability on all reals rather than just on (0,∞)
Nonnegativity hypothesis is stated for all x : ℝ instead of only for t ∈ Ioi 0, again strengthening beyond the domain the informal statement concerns
The conclusion integrates f over the whole real line (∫ f, default Lebesgue measure) instead of over Ioi 0 (∫ x in Ioi 0, f x), changing the stated conclusion's domain of integration

Because the added global hypotheses (antitone + nonneg + integrable on all of ℝ) actually force f to vanish identically on (-∞,0), the produced statement is not equivalent to the gold's general claim but only a restricted/derived special case of it — it excludes valid gold instances where f is arbitrary (e.g. nonzero, non-integrable) on the negative reals
